ext.description: Real-time agent dashboard for AI coding CLIs (Claude Code, Kimi Code): auto-setup hooks, per-project agent view, real subscription plan limits
view.dashboard.name: Dashboard
cmd.openInEditor: AI Office: Open Dashboard in Editor
cmd.emergencyStop: AI Office: Emergency Stop / Resume Agents
cfg.language: Dashboard UI language. "system" follows the OS language even when VSCode itself runs in English.
cfg.hooks.autoSetup: Offer to install agent CLI hooks automatically when they are missing, and keep hook scripts up to date
cfg.hooks.targets: Which agent CLIs to install dashboard hooks into
cfg.hooks.targets.auto: Every CLI whose home directory exists (~/.claude, ~/.kimi-code); both if neither exists
cfg.hooks.targets.both: Both Claude Code and Kimi Code
cfg.statusBar.enabled: Show a status bar item with agent activity; turns into a warning when an agent is waiting for your input
cfg.roster.enabled: Discover agents from the project's agent folders (.claude/agents, .kimi-code/agents, .agents/agents) and show them as idle immediately
cfg.usage.enabled: Show plan usage panel (real subscription limits via your Claude Code / Kimi Code login)
cfg.usage.costSource: Additional cost-estimate bars (USD). "ccusage" spawns `npx ccusage` periodically
cfg.usage.limitBlockUsd: Block limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.usage.limitWeeklyUsd: Weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.usage.limitWeeklyOpusUsd: Opus weekly limit USD (only for the ccusage cost bars)
cfg.usage.degradationAlerts: Warn when a plan quota degrades (running hot / critically low / depleted)
cfg.scope: workspace = this window only; global = all agent CLI sessions
cfg.agentRooms:
Custom agent→room mapping. Merged **over** the built-in defaults. Example: `{"my-custom-agent": "backend", "design-agent": "frontend"}`.

Known rooms: `directors`, `backend`, `frontend`, `qa`, `security`, `devops`, `integrations`, `ai-lab`, `iot`, `lobby`.

Unknown agents are resolved by a keyword heuristic (e.g. `*-director` → directors, `react-*` → frontend); unmatched agents fall back to `lobby`.
